extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners, PTAB stakeholders, researchers, and policymakers interested in AIA trial statistics
extracted.subtask_description: Extracting and interpreting PTAB statistics about AIA petitions (IPR, CBM, PGR) including filings by time and technology, institution rates, dispositions, settlements, and claims-level outcomes. The page is a PTAB statistical report current as of 9/30/2016.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total AIA Petitions (cumulative) by trial type
rubrics_metrics.description: Total number of cumulative AIA petitions filed to date broken out by trial type (i.e., IPR, CBM, and PGR).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Displayed as a pie chart (example: 5656 Total AIA Petitions cumulative from 09/16/2012). Data current as of: 9/30/2016.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of AIA petitions filed by fiscal year and trial type
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of AIA petitions filed each fiscal year, with each fiscal-year bar showing filings broken out by trial type (IPR, CBM, PGR).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Depicted as a bar graph (FY14, FY15, FY16*). '*Data current as of: 9/30/2016.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Monthly filings — IPR petitions
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of IPR petitions filed by month (time series showing monthly counts since AIA trial provisions became effective).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shown as a line graph with monthly counts. '*Data current as of: 9/30/2016.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Monthly filings — CBM petitions
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of CBM petitions filed by month (time series showing monthly counts since AIA trial provisions became effective).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shown as a line graph with monthly counts. '*Data current as of: 9/30/2016.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Monthly filings — PGR petitions
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of PGR petitions filed by month (time series showing monthly counts since AIA trial provisions became effective).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shown as a line graph with monthly counts. '*Data current as of: 9/30/2016.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Monthly filings — Total petitions
rubrics_metrics.description: Total number of all petitions filed each month (aggregate of IPR, CBM, and PGR) from the effective date of the AIA trial provisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Displayed as a line graph showing total monthly filings. '*Data current as of: 9/30/2016.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Technology breakdown of petitions by fiscal year (FY14–FY16)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number and percentage of petitions in the current fiscal year to date broken down by technology categories (Electrical/Computer; Mechanical/Business Method; Chemical; Bio/Pharma; Design).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as pie charts for FY14, FY15, and FY16 (examples: FY16: 935 (55%) Electrical/Computer; 405 (24%) Mechanical/Business Method; etc.). Technology category mapping: Electrical/Computer - TCs 2100, 2400, 2600, 2800; Mechanical/Business Method - TCs 3600, 3700; Chemical - TC 1700; Bio/Pharma - TC 1600; Design - TC 2900. '*Data current as of: 9/30/2016.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent owner preliminary responses by fiscal year (Filed vs Waived/Not Filed)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of patent owner preliminary responses filed and waived/not filed each fiscal year in IPR, CBM, and PGR proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shown as bar graphs for each trial type with categories 'Filed' and 'Waived/Not Filed' (FY14, FY15, FY16*). '*Data current as of: 9/30/2016.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Percent of petitions instituted, by technology
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage of petitions instituted (of all decisions on petition) broken out by technology area (Mechanical/Business Methods, Electrical/Computer, Design, Chemical, Biotechnology/Pharma).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Displayed as a chart with counts and percentages (examples: Mechanical/Business Methods: 773 of 1061 petitions — 73%; Electrical/Computer: 1706 of 2400 petitions — 71%; Design: 8 of 21 petitions — 38%). '*Data current as of: 9/30/2016.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions on institution per fiscal year by outcome (Instituted / Joinders / Denials)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of decisions on institution each fiscal year broken out by outcome: instituted (including joinders), joinders, and denials for IPR, CBM, and PGR proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as bar graphs with counts per fiscal year (FY14, FY15, FY16*). Note: 'A trial that is instituted in part is counted as an institution in these bar graphs.' '*Data current as of: 9/30/2016.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Settlements in AIA trials (before vs after institution)
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of settlements in AIA trials broken down by whether the settlement occurred prior to institution or after institution for IPR, CBM, and PGR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shown as bar graphs with separate bars for 'Settled Before Institution' and 'Settled After Institution' for each fiscal year. '*Data current as of: 9/30/2016.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Disposition of IPR petitions completed to date (outcome categories)
rubrics_metrics.description: Outcomes for all IPR petitions filed to date that have reached a final disposition, including totals for Trials Not Instituted, Trials Instituted, Petitions Denied, Terminations Before Institution Decision (broken into settled, dismissed, request for adverse judgment), Terminations After Institution Decision (settled, dismissed, request for adverse judgment), Trials Completed (Reached Final Written Decision), and counts/percentages for Trials with all instituted claims unpatentable / some instituted claims unpatentable / no instituted claims unpatentable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shown as a 'stepping stone' visual with numeric breakdowns and percentages (example totals: 3672 total petitions; 1771 trials not instituted; 1901 trials instituted; 1214 trials completed; breakdowns of outcomes with percent of total petitions and percent of trials instituted). '*Data current as of: 9/30/2016.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Disposition of CBM petitions completed to date (outcome categories)
rubrics_metrics.description: Outcomes for all CBM petitions filed to date that have reached a final disposition, including Trials Not Instituted, Trials Instituted, Petitions Denied, Terminations Before Institution Decision (settled, dismissed), Terminations After Institution Decision (settled, dismissed, request for adverse judgment), Trials Completed (Reached Final Written Decision), and counts/percentages for trials with all/some/no instituted claims unpatentable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shown as a 'stepping stone' visual with numeric breakdowns (example totals: 391 total petitions; 176 trials not instituted; 215 trials instituted; 143 trials completed; percentages provided for outcomes). '*Data current as of: 9/30/2016.'

rubrics_metrics.name: IPR petitions claims-level termination breakdown (claims available → challenged → instituted → final outcomes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Claims flow visualization for IPR petitions showing total number of claims available to be challenged, claims challenged vs not challenged, claims on which trial was instituted vs not instituted, and final outcomes: claims found unpatentable in final written decision, claims cancelled/disclaimed by patent owner, claims remaining patentable (not subject to final written decision), and claims found patentable by PTAB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as four cylinders with numeric counts (examples: Total claims available within 3672 petitions; Claims challenged: 56233; Claims instituted: 25626; Claims found unpatentable by PTAB in final written decision: 13140; Claims cancelled or disclaimed: 2220; Claims found patentable by PTAB in final written decision: 3519; Claims remaining patentable (not subject to final written decision): 6747). Note: 'Completed' petitions include terminations (before or after a decision on institution) due to settlement, request for adverse judgment, or dismissal; final written decisions; and decisions denying institution. '*Data current as of: 9/30/2016.'

rubrics_metrics.name: CBM petitions claims-level termination breakdown (claims available → challenged → instituted → final outcomes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Claims flow visualization for CBM petitions showing total number of claims available to be challenged, claims challenged vs not challenged, claims on which trial was instituted vs not instituted, and final outcomes: claims found unpatentable in final written decision, claims cancelled/disclaimed by patent owner, claims remaining patentable (not subject to final written decision), and claims found patentable by PTAB.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Displayed as four cylinders with numeric counts (examples: Total claims available within 391 petitions: 13832; Claims challenged: 7424; Claims instituted: 3374; Claims found unpatentable by PTAB in final written decision: 2031; Claims cancelled or disclaimed: 301; Claims found patentable by PTAB: 73; Claims remaining patentable (not subject to final written decision): 969). Note repeats the definition of 'Completed' petitions. '*Data current as of: 9/30/2016.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Trial outcomes for instituted claims by technology
rubrics_metrics.description: Claim-level outcomes for instituted trials by technology area showing percentages for: Claims Found Unpatentable by PTAB in Final Written Decision; Claims Cancelled or Disclaimed by Patent Owner; Claims Found Patentable by PTAB in Final Written Decision.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as a chart with per-technology percentages (examples: Mechanical/Business Methods (8364 claims): 47% unpatentable, 10% cancelled/disclaimed, 10% patentable; Electrical/Computer (16600 claims): 54% unpatentable, 8% cancelled/disclaimed, 12% patentable; Biotechnology/Pharma: 40% unpatentable, 8% cancelled/disclaimed, 32% patentable; Design: 100% unpatentable). Note: 'Claims involved in instituted trials that settle or are dismissed are not depicted. Accordingly, a bar may not add up to 100%.' '*Data current as of: 9/30/2016.'
